name: Windows Health & Network Stack Repair
description: Runs Windows system file repair (SFC) and network recovery (DNS flush, DHCP release/renew, Winsock reset). Every repair is PIN-gated and supports a dry run that only describes its impact.

tools.name: System File Checker (sfc /scannow)
tools.description: Scans all protected Windows system files and replaces corrupted ones. Takes 5-20 minutes. Requires administrator rights.

tools.name: Flush DNS Resolver Cache
tools.description: Clears the Windows DNS client cache (ipconfig /flushdns). Harmless; names are looked up again on next use.

tools.name: IP Release & Renew
tools.description: Releases and renews DHCP IPv4 leases (ipconfig /release then /renew), optionally for adapters matching a name filter such as *Wi-Fi*. Drops network connections for a few seconds. Requires administrator rights.

adapterFilter.description: Adapter name or wildcard pattern; empty means all adapters.

tools.name: Reset Winsock Catalog
tools.description: Resets the Winsock catalog to defaults (netsh winsock reset). Removes third-party network providers such as some VPN or security software hooks. Needs a reboot to finish. Requires administrator rights.

tools.name: AI Health Output Advisor
tools.description: Asks the LLM service to interpret output from SFC, ipconfig, or netsh and suggest next steps.
